supporting_observations.claim: The observed HTTPS attempts to update.gradebookpro.com occurred at roughly five-minute intervals: 13:38:54, 13:44:02, 13:48:40, 13:53:57, 13:58:20, 14:03:36, and 14:08:46. The 13:48:40 attempt was denied and the 13:58:20 attempt returned a gateway error.

The updater process C:\Program Files\GradeBookPro\gradebookproupd.exe was running on WS-RDIAZ-01 during the observed activity, and Sysmon network events attribute the proxy connections to that process.

The destination matches the organization's approved GradeBook Pro updater service, which is expected to check update.gradebookpro.com about every five minutes. The timing, destination, and process attribution support a benign explanation for the alerted activity.
The updater process exited at 14:08:56, shortly after the final observed connection.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT metadata and tunnel byte counts, not the encrypted content or the exact update data transferred (for example, T296-00073 and T296-00148).

The process and network records identify the GradeBook Pro updater path and PID but do not establish the executable's hash, signature validity, or the safety of any downloaded update (T296-00069, T296-00074).
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish what content, if any, was transferred inside the HTTPS tunnels or whether an update was downloaded or applied (for example, T296-00073, T296-00148, T296-00162).
The evidence does not establish whether there were additional connections before the first observed attempt at 13:38:54.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: Explorer set the user's Internet Settings ProxyEnable value to 0 at 13:22:59; this is not part of the alerted GradeBook updater connections (T296-00021).

Separate review: a UserAssist registry entry at 13:28:46 contains a ROT13-encoded path consistent with mstsc.exe; the available record does not establish authorization or show a corresponding process-creation event (T296-00034).
